sources.scope: 114 valid distinct Palm Beach County Property Appraiser GIS reference polygons in thirteen bounded cells around the unchanged UN WUP West Palm Beach settlement locator. Native count/OID manifests, forced three-row pages, fresh GIS-ID geometry reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding pass. Metric EPSG32617 topology found no sampled overlap or errors. The county sample contains the locator; the separate municipal parcel layer extent excludes it. This serves the WUP settlement location using county ground and makes no West Palm Beach municipal-only coverage claim. Documented PCN/PARID is nonunique across geometry features, so it is not the runtime key.
